svg.text: A high-level walkthrough of the request & data flow across the AWS deployment
— follow the numbered steps ① → ⑥ in the diagram above

text.tspan: AWS Amplify builds and serves the React + Vite
single-page app over global HTTPS, with CI/CD on
The user signs in through Amazon Cognito (OAuth2 /
OIDC). The app receives a signed JWT access token.
The SPA calls the AWS Lambda backend (Express) with
Axios, attaching the JWT as a Bearer token.
Lambda validates every JWT against Cognito public
Lambda reads and writes notes and whiteboard
sessions in Amazon DynamoDB via the AWS SDK.
Live edits stream over Socket.IO WebSockets through
Lambda and broadcast to every session participant.
